Title: Service Tag Discovery API is now available in preview

Body.Content:
Service Tag Discovery API is now in preview.

Service Tag Discovery API helps you to more easily maintain your dependencies on Azure IP ranges with a programmatic interface to retrieve global IP address information for Azure and its services.

We currently publish JSON files every week that include IP ranges for each cloud, broken out by Azure service and region:

  • Public cloud
  • US Gov
  • Germany
  • China

This information is now available to customers and partners without the need to rely on  manually downloading these files.

Read more about Service Tag Discovery API.
